title: ALTER COLUMN TYPE on large table — full rewrite with AccessExclusiveLock
expected_feedback: Standard: ALTER COLUMN TYPE from text to jsonb requires a full table rewrite with AccessExclusiveLock -- the USING clause changes the column contents, so the documented no-rewrite exemption does not apply. On a 50M-row table this blocks all queries for minutes to hours and needs up to double the disk space. pg_repack cannot change a column type; use expand-contract (add a new jsonb column, backfill in keyset batches, dual-write, then drop the old column). Also: SET LOCAL outside a transaction block has no effect.
